title: CryoWeave: Risk-Budgeted AI Co-Design of Cryoprotectant Loading and Nanowarming for Organ-Scale Cryobanking
description: Theoretical and computational proposal for uncertainty-aware joint optimization of cryoprotectant loading and nanowarming. Includes a dimensionless reduced-order toy model and executable mathematical checks. These simulations are not experimental cryopreservation evidence and do not provide an operational or clinical protocol. No DOI has been issued by this artifact.
